name: Return to MacKinley
summary: You carry Phillipe’s pouch to Sea Wolf MacKinley, who is owed payment. Phillipe says he meant to pay all along and asks that you go easy.

sections.title: Shaky's Plea
sections.body: "Shaky" Phillipe hands you a pouch of payment for Sea Wolf MacKinley. He swears he always meant to repay the debt. Phillipe says he got a little drunk and lost the way. He thinks MacKinley will understand, and insists there is no need to get rough.

sections.title: Sea Wolf Hears the Tale
sections.body: Sea Wolf MacKinley chuckles as he recalls showing Phillipe the giblets. He asks how hard Phillipe shook. MacKinley says Phillipe is easy to read, and that winning comes without effort when they play cards.

aliases: where do i start return to mackinley
faq.answer: "Shaky" Phillipe gives you a pouch of payment for Sea Wolf MacKinley.

faq.q: What excuse does Phillipe give for not paying?
faq.answer: Phillipe says he got a little drunk and lost the way, but swears he always meant to repay the debt.

aliases: what comes before return to mackinley
faq.answer: Before this, MacKinley had you frighten Phillipe with giblets in Scaring Shaky.
